shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在走廊里，头顶有烟感探测器和喷头，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a corridor under a ceiling smoke detector and a sprinkler head, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲火灾报警与消防设施。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱堆在走廊红色箱子前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stacks cardboard boxes in front of a red wall cabinet in the corridor.
shots.narration: 阿杰把纸箱堆在红色箱子前。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李走过来摇头，指着箱子和天花板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over, shakes his head and points at the cabinet and the ceiling.
shots.narration: 老李说：这些都是救命的消防设施。

shots.section_title: 进实验室，先认报警和应急设施
shots.scene: 王老师带新生在楼层里认设施
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks new students along the floor, pointing at safety equipment.
shots.narration: 向负责人了解报警和应急系统。
overlay: 进实验室，先认报警和应急设施

shots.section_title: 进实验室，先认报警和应急设施
shots.scene: 楼层平面图上标出报警按钮、消火栓、出口
shots.prompt_en: A blank floor plan with icons for alarm buttons, hydrant cabinets and exits. No text.
shots.narration: 报警按钮在哪，警报响了怎么办。

shots.section_title: 进实验室，先认报警和应急设施
shots.scene: 小研站在报警按钮前亲眼确认
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a wall-mounted fire alarm button, looking at it closely.
shots.narration: 要到现场亲眼看，亲手找到。

shots.section_title: 手动报警按钮：发现火情先按它
shots.scene: 手动报警按钮挂在墙上，前面空着
shots.prompt_en: A red manual fire alarm call point on a corridor wall with clear space in front. No people.
shots.narration: 最基础的报警，靠人手动启动。
overlay: 手动报警按钮：发现火情先按它

shots.section_title: 手动报警按钮：发现火情先按它
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校手动火灾报警按钮特写（只拍外观，不按下）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red manual fire alarm call point mounted on a wall.
shots.narration: 这是手动火灾报警按钮。

shots.section_title: 手动报警按钮：发现火情先按它
shots.scene: 阿杰发现火情，用力按下报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees smoke and firmly presses the manual alarm button.
shots.narration: 发现火情，先按下它报警。

shots.section_title: 手动报警按钮：发现火情先按它
shots.scene: 按钮前堆着杂物，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A manual alarm button blocked by a stack of boxes, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 报警按钮前，别堆东西。

shots.section_title: 自动报警：信号送到消防控制室
shots.scene: 探测器、按钮通过线路连到控制器
shots.prompt_en: Detectors and alarm buttons connected by lines to a fire alarm control panel. No text.
shots.narration: 自动报警系统，由探测器和控制器组成。
overlay: 自动报警：信号送到消防控制室

shots.section_title: 自动报警：信号送到消防控制室
shots.scene: 信号经专线、电话线、光缆或无线传送
shots.prompt_en: Alarm signals travel along a cable, a phone line, an optical fiber and a wireless wave icon. No text.
shots.narration: 信号经专线、光缆或无线送出。

shots.section_title: 自动报警：信号送到消防控制室
shots.scene: 消防控制室，保卫处值班员看到报警
shots.prompt_en: In a fire control room, the security officer sees an alarm light up on the control panel.
shots.narration: 送到消防控制室，有人值守。

shots.section_title: 自动报警：信号送到消防控制室
shots.scene: 值班员拿起电话核实
shots.prompt_en: The security officer picks up the phone to confirm the alarm location.
shots.narration: 值班员马上核实，组织处置。

shots.section_title: 探测器：感温、差温、感烟
shots.scene: 温度计升到警戒线，探测器亮灯
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rises past a mark and a heat detector lights up. No text.
shots.narration: 温度到了，感温探测器报警。

shots.section_title: 探测器：感温、差温、感烟
shots.scene: 温度曲线陡然上升，探测器亮灯
shots.prompt_en: A temperature curve shoots up steeply and a detector lights up. No text.
shots.narration: 升温太快，差温探测器报警。

shots.section_title: 探测器：感温、差温、感烟
shots.scene: 烟雾飘进感烟探测器，指示灯闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Smoke drifts into a ceiling smoke detector and its indicator light flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 烟雾来了，感烟探测器报警。

shots.section_title: 感烟探测器：光电型和离子型
shots.scene: 两个感烟探测器并排：光电型、离子型
shots.prompt_en: Two smoke detectors side by side, one with a light beam icon, one with a small atom icon. No text.
shots.narration: 感烟探测器分光电型和离子型。
overlay: 感烟探测器：光电型和离子型

shots.section_title: 感烟探测器：光电型和离子型
shots.scene: 冒浓烟、没有明火的阴燃，光电型先亮
shots.prompt_en: Smoldering material gives off thick smoke without flames; the light-beam detector lights first. No people.
shots.narration: 光电型对冒烟的阴燃火更灵敏。

shots.section_title: 感烟探测器：光电型和离子型
shots.scene: 燃烧迅速的明火，离子型先亮
shots.prompt_en: A fast flaming fire with little smoke; the atom-icon detector lights first. No people.
shots.narration: 离子型对明火反应更快。

shots.section_title: 感烟探测器：光电型和离子型
shots.scene: 两个探测器都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both detectors get green checks. No text.
shots.narration: 两种各有所长，按设计配置。

shots.section_title: 自动喷水：直接洒向火点，帮人逃生
shots.scene: 喷头玻璃球受热破裂，水洒向火点
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler head's glass bulb bursts from heat and water sprays down onto a fire. No people.
shots.narration: 自动喷水，受热就直接洒向火点。
overlay: 自动喷水：直接洒向火点，帮人逃生

shots.section_title: 自动喷水：直接洒向火点，帮人逃生
shots.scene: 水压住火势，烟和热减少
shots.prompt_en: The water spray holds the fire down and the smoke and heat shrink. No people.
shots.narration: 限制烟和热，楼上的人更容易撤离。

shots.section_title: 自动喷水：直接洒向火点，帮人逃生
shots.scene: 一排喷头，每个下面一个圆形保护区
shots.prompt_en: A row of ceiling sprinkler heads, each with a circular coverage area beneath that overlap. No text.
shots.narration: 每个喷头只管一小片，排起来盖满。

shots.section_title: 自动喷水：直接洒向火点，帮人逃生
shots.scene: 随意加隔断挡住喷头，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A new partition wall blocks a sprinkler's spray area, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 间距按规范布置，不能随便改。

shots.section_title: 水流报警与干式系统（了解）
shots.scene: 喷淋管中水流动，报警阀处警铃响
shots.prompt_en: Water flows inside a sprinkler pipe and an alarm bell rings at the valve station. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋管里有水流动，就会报警。
overlay: 水流报警与干式系统（了解）

shots.section_title: 水流报警与干式系统（了解）
shots.scene: 寒冷地区的干式系统，管里充着气
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler pipe in a freezing area filled with air instead of water, snowflake icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 会结冰的地方，用干式系统。

shots.section_title: 水流报警与干式系统（了解）
shots.scene: 干式阀上下两块压力表，上低下高
shots.prompt_en: A dry pipe valve with two pressure gauges, the upper one reading lower than the lower one. No text.
shots.narration: 阀上方气压明显低于下方水压。

shots.section_title: 水流报警与干式系统（了解）
shots.scene: 喷头一开，气压下降，水冲进管道
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler opens, air rushes out and water surges into the pipe. No text.
shots.narration: 喷头一开气压降，水就冲进来。

shots.section_title: 室内消火栓：箱前不能堆东西
shots.scene: 走廊墙上的室内消火栓箱
shots.prompt_en: A red indoor fire hydrant cabinet set into a corridor wall. No people.
shots.narration: 这是室内消火栓箱。
overlay: 室内消火栓：箱前不能堆东西

shots.section_title: 室内消火栓：箱前不能堆东西
shots.scene: 【实拍】打开本校消火栓箱，镜头扫过水带、水枪和阀门（只拍外观，不放水）
shots.prompt_en: A hydrant cabinet door opens to show a rolled hose, a nozzle and a valve inside.
shots.narration: 里面有水带、水枪和阀门。

shots.section_title: 室内消火栓：箱前不能堆东西
shots.scene: 消防员接水带取水的示意
shots.prompt_en: A hose is connected to the hydrant valve and water flows to the nozzle. No faces.
shots.narration: 它是灭火取水的接口。

shots.section_title: 室内消火栓：箱前不能堆东西
shots.scene: 湿式栓体里有水，干式没水防冻
shots.prompt_en: Two hydrant icons: one pipe full of water, one empty with a snowflake. No text.
shots.narration: 湿式里面有水，干式没水防冻。

shots.section_title: 室内消火栓：箱前不能堆东西
shots.scene: 消火栓箱前堆纸箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes piled in front of a hydrant cabinet, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 箱前不能堆东西，不能遮挡。

shots.section_title: 水泵接合器：前面不停车、不堆物
shots.scene: 外墙上的水泵接合器，消防车接上水带
shots.prompt_en: A pump connection on the outside wall of a building, with a hose from a fire truck attached. No faces.
shots.narration: 消防车通过外墙的水泵接合器供水。
overlay: 水泵接合器：前面不停车、不堆物

shots.section_title: 水泵接合器：前面不停车、不堆物
shots.scene: 接合器前停着车、堆着杂物，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A car parked and junk piled in front of the wall pump connection, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 接合器前不能停车、堆东西。

shots.section_title: 气体灭火房间：报警后马上撤离
shots.scene: 机房门口有气体灭火警示标志，警报响
shots.prompt_en: A server room door with a gas extinguishing system warning sign; an alarm light flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 有的房间装的是气体灭火系统。
overlay: 气体灭火房间：报警后马上撤离

shots.section_title: 气体灭火房间：报警后马上撤离
shots.scene: 老周听到预警，立刻走出房间
shots.prompt_en: The older man hears the pre-discharge alarm and immediately walks out of the room.
shots.narration: 报警后到放气前，人要马上离开。

shots.section_title: 气体灭火房间：报警后马上撤离
shots.scene: 放气后，门口禁止进入，打叉
shots.prompt_en: After discharge, entering the room is crossed out; the facility engineer waits outside.
shots.narration: 放气后别进去，等专业人员处理。

shots.section_title: 探测器和喷头：不遮挡、不停用、定期测试
shots.scene: 喷头上挂着衣物，下面堆着高货架，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat hung on a sprinkler head and tall shelves stacked right below it, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 喷头上不挂东西，下方不堆高物。
overlay: 探测器和喷头：不遮挡、不停用、定期测试

shots.section_title: 探测器和喷头：不遮挡、不停用、定期测试
shots.scene: 烟感探测器被塑料袋罩住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A smoke detector covered with a plastic bag, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不能遮挡烟感，不能擅自停用。

shots.section_title: 探测器和喷头：不遮挡、不停用、定期测试
shots.scene: 阿杰要做会产烟的操作，先向王老师报备
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator for approval before a task that makes smoke.
shots.narration: 会产烟的操作，先报备再处理。

shots.section_title: 探测器和喷头：不遮挡、不停用、定期测试
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校实验室天花板上的感烟探测器和喷头外观特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a ceiling smoke detector with its indicator light and a nearby sprinkler head.
shots.narration: 认清烟感和喷头的样子。

shots.section_title: 探测器和喷头：不遮挡、不停用、定期测试
shots.scene: 老李定期测试探测器，指示灯异常就报修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests a smoke detector with a tester pole and notes a faulty light for repair.
shots.narration: 定期测试，指示灯异常马上报修。

shots.section_title: 消防设施和通道前不堆物
shots.scene: 灭火器、电箱、出口前都堆着东西，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Boxes piled in front of an extinguisher, an electrical panel and an exit door, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、电箱、出口前不准堆东西。
overlay: 消防设施和通道前不堆物

shots.section_title: 消防设施和通道前不堆物
shots.scene: 清理后的走廊，通道畅通，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A cleared corridor with an unobstructed path to the exit, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 疏散通道时刻保持畅通。

shots.section_title: 消防设施和通道前不堆物
shots.scene: 消防设施被损坏、挪用的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a broken alarm button and a removed extinguisher, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不得损坏、挪用、擅自停用消防设施。

shots.section_title: 防火门常闭，不用东西顶住
shots.scene: 楼道里的防火门关着
shots.prompt_en: A closed fire door in a stairwell corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 楼道里的防火门，平时要关着。
overlay: 防火门常闭，不用东西顶住

shots.section_title: 防火门常闭，不用东西顶住
shots.scene: 防火门被纸箱、楔子顶开，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fire door propped open with a wedge and a box, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用纸箱、楔子把它顶开。

shots.section_title: 防火门常闭，不用东西顶住
shots.scene: 门一侧有烟火，另一侧干净
shots.prompt_en: Smoke and fire on one side of a closed fire door, the other side clear. No people.
shots.narration: 关着的门，能把烟火挡在外面。

shots.section_title: 防火门常闭，不用东西顶住
shots.scene: 门关不上，老李报修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer notes that a fire door will not close fully and reports it for repair.
shots.narration: 门关不上了，及时报修。

shots.section_title: 声光警报响了，立即撤离
shots.scene: 控制器显示报警，走廊声光警报器闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A fire alarm control panel lights up and a strobe sounder on the corridor wall flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 控制器收到信号，声光警报响起。
overlay: 声光警报响了，立即撤离

shots.section_title: 声光警报响了，立即撤离
shots.scene: 学生放下手中实验，关掉热源，起身撤离
shots.prompt_en: Students stop work, switch off heat sources and leave the lab calmly.
shots.narration: 警报一响，停下实验，立即撤离。

shots.section_title: 声光警报响了，立即撤离
shots.scene: 以为是误报继续实验，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A student keeps working while the alarm sounds, assuming it is a false alarm, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 别以为是误报，不要等着看。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 报警按钮、探测器、喷头、消火栓、防火门五个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five icons get green checks: alarm button, detector, sprinkler, hydrant cabinet, fire door. No text.
shots.narration: 报警按钮会按，消防设施认得清。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 设施前通道清空，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Clear space in front of every fire safety device, with green checks. No text.
shots.narration: 不遮挡、不堆物、不损坏。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在绿色安全出口标志下，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands under a green emergency exit sign and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲火警报告与疏散逃生。
